nodes.name: Shopify Order Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives POST from Shopify when new order is placed. Configure in Shopify Admin > Settings > Notifications > Webhooks > Order creation

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp Message
nodes.notes: Requires WhatsApp Business API access token in HTTP Header Auth credential named 'WhatsApp API'. Set Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN

nodes.name: Notify Pawmeals Backend
nodes.notes: Notifies the Pawmeals EC2 backend to log the WhatsApp confirmation and trigger Klaviyo order event

_pawmeals_setup_notes.step1: Import this JSON into your n8n instance (New Workflow > Import from JSON)
_pawmeals_setup_notes.step3: Create HTTP Header Auth credential named 'WhatsApp API' with your Meta WhatsApp token
_pawmeals_setup_notes.step4: Activate the workflow and copy the webhook URL
_pawmeals_setup_notes.step5: In Shopify Admin > Settings > Notifications > Webhooks, add the webhook URL for 'Order creation' event
